messages:
Lina: heads-up — active incident INC-3245 (router spike eu-west-1). paging still firing. I'm on the bridge but need to hand driving over; heading offline in ~10m for an ETA call.

oncall-bot: :rotating_light: Pager opened INC-3245 — increased 5xx from inference-router in eu-west-1. Current P1.

Lina: current status: 5xx spike started ~12m ago, error rate ~18% across requests, latency up. We already rolled one quick restart on router-02 which gave a small dip.
metrics link: https://dash.redwood.dev/d/routers/eu-west-1?orgId=1&var-cluster=prod
runbook: https://redwood.dev/runbooks/router-spike

Marcus: taking driving. confirm I should continue with the scale + rolling-restart plan?

Lina: yes. Plan A: scale router pool by +2, drain & restart heavy pods, watch for cache warm-up. If no improvement in 8m, revert and fallback to model-variant route for critical customers.

Priya: I'll take comms/updates. I'll send a public status and ping support.

Marcus: ack. Starting with: 
```bash
# scale up router deployment
kubectl -n inference deploy/inference-router scale --replicas=$(($(kubectl -n inference get deploy inference-router -o jsonpath='{.spec.replicas}')+2))
# identify top erroring pods
kubectl -n inference logs deploy/inference-router -c proxy --since=10m | tail -n 200
```

Marcus: scaling now. pinging infra to confirm quota but should be fine.

deploy-bot: Rolling restart queued for deployment inference-router in eu-west-1 by Marcus. JobID: rb-82431.

Tariq: FYI I'm limited availability until 02:00 UTC — can be backup for comms if needed but might be slow on deep debugging.

Priya: noted. I'll post initial status update now: short summary + mitigation steps + expected next update in 15 min. tagging #support and customers list.

Lina: coverage gap: secondary (Tariq) partial. If Marcus needs a second engineer for deep dives (kernel/k8s), call @infra-oncall.

Marcus: first scale completed, pods coming up. Observability: tail latency dropping ~6% but errors still at ~12%. continuing with rolling restart on pods showing high 5xx.

Marcus: quick grep in logs shows repeated upstream connection reset for service backend-auth. adding a check: `kubectl -n services rollout status deploy/backend-auth` and checking proxy conn limits.

Priya: status update posted: https://status.redwood.dev/incidents/INC-3245 — added mitigation and the who/what. Will update users after next check.

Lina: handing off formally — Marcus is drive owner. Priya is comms owner. Lina stepping out (phone on). Backup for comms is Tariq. Backup for drive is infra-oncall (escalate via PD).

Marcus: accepted. I'll post a short play-by-play in this thread every 8-10m. First checkpoint in 6m.

Marcus: (6m later) rolling restarts finished, error rate down to 4.3%, latency trending down. Leaving watch on for 20m.

Priya: update sent to customers. flagging one large customer (acme-corp) for follow-up — their flows went to 502s. I'll coordinate a postmortem trigger if we see regression.

Lina: thanks team. Handoff complete. If anything regresses, Marcus drive + Priya comms until resolved. :white_check_mark:
